column1: NB. Please note that for children 0-14 years, data was collected via the child's parent/guardian for organised participation outside of school hours

NB. Estimated participant numbers have not been rounded but users must remember that they are estimates and are subject to margins of error. Refer to sheet number 38 for margin of error and relative margin of error statistics.
^ The proportion of participants' parents/guardians and adults who paid money to an organisation/venue to participate
* Estimate has relative margin of error between 50% and 100% and should be used with caution
** Estimate has relative margin of error greater than 100% and is considered too unreliable to use
